lcc_original: 以下是亞當後代的記錄。當上帝創造人【1】的日子，他是按着自己的樣式造他的：
notes: 以下 treated as explicit for H2088 (demonstrative 'this/the following') — braces dropped per Rule 3; borderline since 以下 means 'the following below' rather than 'this' directly
{<WH0430>} kept implicit on 自己的: the possessive suffix refers back to God (H430) but LCC's 自己 represents only the reflexive function, not God as lexeme
Second 他 (direct object 'him') takes <WAH0853> with braces dropped — explicit pronoun for the Hebrew direct object marker
First 他 (subject 'he') left unannotated — subject implied in Hebrew verb conjugation, no corresponding SN in UNV
WAH09002 applied to both 按着 and 樣式 to mirror UNV's double-tagging pattern for the ב prepositional prefix on בִּדְמוּתֹו
